findings.title: A left-to-right field typed right to left
findings.message: This number field inherits right to left.
findings.fix: Add dir="ltr" to the input, or dir="auto" if people may type Arabic too.

findings.title: A back or next arrow drawn pointing the wrong way
findings.message: This back arrow points left in right-to-left. It should point right.
findings.fix: In right to left, draw the arrow the other way, mirror it with a :dir(rtl) { transform: scaleX(-1) } rule, or swap the glyph, such as ← for →.

findings.title: No Arabic font in the stack
findings.message: Arabic falls back from Segoe UI, Tahoma, Geneva, Verdana, sans-serif.
findings.fix: Load an Arabic family with @font-face or a font link and name it in the stack, for example "IBM Plex Sans Arabic".

findings.title: No Arabic font in the stack

findings.title: Spacing that does not mirror
findings.message: margin-left: 8px stays on the same side in Arabic.
findings.fix: Use margin-inline-start, padding-inline-end and the other logical properties.
